summary: Completed requested read-only verification for Supplier Assessment GHG simplified persistence across backend APIs, runtime references, and supplier/admin UI flows.

integration_issues.issue: Repeated 404 calls to /api/organization/module-config observed in browser console during supplier/admin sessions.

action_items: Investigate why /api/organization/module-config returns 404 for authenticated users (supplier and admin).
Optionally add this Supplier GHG simplified live suite to CI smoke runs for regression protection.
critical_code_review_comments: No runtime references to removed collections supplier_ghg_entries/supplier_ghg_submissions remain in backend modules or frontend source.
supplier_assessment/router.py remains oversized (>700 lines), increasing change-risk concentration for supplier GHG/API edits.
SupplierGHGView has interactive controls (search input and scope filter) without explicit data-testid attributes, reducing testability consistency.
seed_data_creation: None. No GHG submit, no emission create, no update/delete, no database mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified live supplier GHG submission screen shows legacy Scope 1 draft total 103.73 tCO2e and draft rows; verified parent /supplier-assessment/ghg shows submitted aggregation empty state and totals 0. Backend tests asserted parent emissions endpoint returns submitted-only records and excludes supplier unsubmitted draft IDs. Only read-only GETs + auth login POST were used.
rca of the issue: Observed console 404 on /api/organization/module-config appears unrelated to the Supplier GHG simplification but occurs consistently after login in both roles; likely a missing/disabled endpoint or stale frontend bootstrap call path.
